name: explainer-video
description: Turn an article, news story, report findings or a table into a short explainer video: motion graphics rendered in JavaScript, exported as MP4 in your browser. 15–60 s in 9:16 (Reels, Shorts, TikTok), 1:1, 4:5 or 16:9, in the same design system as chart-dashboard and social-post. Every figure comes from your source with its hedges kept, and the video ends on a dated source card. One standalone HTML file: no other apps, no CDN, works offline; never posts.
